source: &7 Ack! Cobalt 3, camouflage compromised!
target: &7 啊！钴蓝三号，迷彩暴露了！

source: &8 Target sighted.
target: &8 发现目标。

source: &1585 I need to use the fact I can see him now to my advantage.
target: &1585 现在能看见他了，我得利用这个优势。

source: &1586 If I wander out there, I'm probably just going to end up full of holes.
target: &1586 走出去，恐怕只会被打成筛子。

source: &129 Wait!
&3888 What is it?
&9 Cobalt Actual, this is Cobalt 3. Dynamic entry complete.
target: &9 钴蓝指挥官，这里是钴蓝三号。强行突入完成。

source: &10 Second floor hallway secure. Going dark and starting patrol. Out.
target: &10 二楼走廊安全。进入隐蔽状态，开始巡逻。通话结束。

source: &1587 Adaptive camouflage?!
target: &1587 自适应迷彩？！

source: &1588 How am I supposed to get past them when I can't even SEE them?
target: &1588 连看都看不见，我怎么绕过他们？

source: &130 I'll see if I can breach their systems...
target: &130 我试试看，能不能侵入他们的系统……

source: &131 For now...you're going to have to think your way past.
target: &131 暂时……你得动脑筋想办法过去。

source: &1589 The door into the office.
target: &1589 通往办公室的门。

source: &1590 That's the way out to the stairwell.
target: &1590 这边通往楼梯间。

source: &1591 I shouldn't wander around the building.
target: &1591 最好别在楼里到处乱走。

source: &1592 A passing aerostat might pick up the movement on their scanners.
target: &1592 经过的浮空艇，可能会用扫描仪发现动静。

source: &1593 I think they call that a 'dynamic entry'.
target: &1593 这种做法，他们好像叫“强行突入”。

source: &1594 I don't think I can climb back out of there!
target: &1594 我应该没法从那里爬回去！

source: &1595 Whatever's in there, there's apparently 'four gross' of them...whatever that means.
target: &1595 不管装的是什么，显然有“四罗”……鬼知道这是什么意思。

source: &1596 The wood's old, but I still can't get it open by hand.
target: &1596 木头虽然旧了，可还是没法徒手打开。

source: &1597 There's nothing but packing material in here, and I've got as much as I want.
target: &1597 里面只有包装填料，我已经拿够了。

source: &1598 It's empty - except for all the packing material.
target: &1598 空的，除了这些包装填料。

source: Picked up: Packing Material
target: 已拾取：包装填料

source: &1599 That's one way of getting it open.
target: &1599 这也是一种打开的办法。

source: &1600 The camouflage ain't giving him an advantage anymore.
target: &1600 迷彩再也帮不了他了。

source: &2006 They're just the sprinklers. The fire sensor must be somewhere else.
target: &2006 只是些喷淋装置。火警传感器肯定在别处。

source: &525 This room is protected against fire by the suppression system. You wonder if it still works after so long.
target: &525 这个房间有灭火系统保护。过了这么久，你不知道它还能不能运作。
